added_entries.title_zh: 尺度描述、误差与具体条件
added_entries.title_en: Scale descriptions, error and particular conditions
added_entries.claim_zh: 同一历史的变化描述可在明确误差界内组合，并支持逐项条件判断；精确总量仍可能遗漏具体损失，组织变化可使旧描述失效。
added_entries.claim_en: Changing descriptions of one history compose under explicit error bounds and support indexed condition judgments; exact totals can still omit particular losses, and organizational change can defeat an earlier description.
added_entries.scope_zh: 21项新 Lean 定理；有限时域条件推论，法则、校准和阈值根据另明示；非经验验证或普遍伦理证明
added_entries.scope_en: 21 new Lean theorems; conditional finite-horizon inference with laws, calibration and threshold warrant explicit; no empirical validation or universal ethical proof

added_entries.title_zh: 尺度近似与条件传递的形式检查
added_entries.title_en: Formal checks of scale approximation and condition transport
added_entries.claim_zh: 有限时域误差递推、两尺度组合、指标校准和条件传递经过实查，并保留耦合变化、误差累积及总量丢失局部条件的反例。
added_entries.claim_en: Checked finite-horizon error propagation, two-scale composition, readout calibration and condition transport retain counterexamples for changed coupling, accumulated error and local conditions lost by exact totals.
added_entries.scope_zh: 21项新定理／42项继承审计；依赖标准逻辑，未构造自动尺度发现或控制策略转换
added_entries.scope_en: 21 new theorems / 42 inherited audits; standard logical dependencies, without automatic scale discovery or controller synthesis
